description: Authoritative machine-readable manifest of Aperture security and threat boundaries, entry points, mitigations, validation bounds, and test coverage

boundaries.name: Updater, Cryptographic Verification, and Release Packaging Trust
boundaries.trustLevel: Untrusted remote network payload; pinned cryptographic trust
boundaries.privilegeContext: Standard user session; isolated child helper '--update-helper' strictly parent-PID verified
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: data/updater.json (state only; suppressed in private mode); atomic swap into root
boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Compromise of offline code-signing / manifest private keys or user-explicit execution in unpinned test mode.

boundaries.name: Same-User Single-Instance IPC & Playback Automation
boundaries.trustLevel: Same-user desktop process; untrusted input across user session
boundaries.privilegeContext: Standard user desktop session; token SID and session ID match required
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: None (in-memory state update only; session save on normal exit)
boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Malicious code executing under the identical user account and session token could send valid automation commands.

boundaries.name: Dynamic Library Loading & Process Search Path Hardening
boundaries.trustLevel: Local filesystem binaries; untrusted CWD / search path
boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Attacker with write permissions to the application directory could plant modified root-local DLLs.

boundaries.name: External Tool Execution Disabled
boundaries.trustLevel: External binaries on filesystem or system PATH
boundaries.privilegeContext: Standard user process; external subprocesses are disabled

validationRules.subprocessExecution: mpv ytdl disabled; scripts and external tool options rejected

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Media is handled in process; no external tool discovery or execution path exists.

boundaries.name: Network Stream Validation & URL Parsing Boundary
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: data/recent_streams.json (state only; suppressed in private mode)

validationRules.credentialRedaction: Sensitive user/password masked in UI and logs

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Exploitation of underlying libmpv / FFmpeg network demuxers by a hostile remote media streaming server.

boundaries.name: Online Subtitle Search & Download Boundary
boundaries.trustLevel: Untrusted third-party HTTP/HTTPS endpoints and subtitle file payloads
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: cache/subtitles/ (disposable cache; segregated from durable data/)

validationRules.httpsEnforced: true (HTTPS required for all subtitle endpoint requests)

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Third-party subtitle provider serving malformed subtitle text designed to trigger parser bugs.

boundaries.name: Media Container, Playlist, and Subtitle File Parsing
boundaries.trustLevel: Untrusted user-supplied local or network media, playlist, and subtitle files
boundaries.privilegeContext: Standard user process; worker threads with cooperative cancellation
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: data/library.json, data/playlists.json (metadata only; never modifies source media or writes sidecars)
boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Zero-day vulnerability in media container demuxers or subtitle rendering engines when opening specially crafted media files.

boundaries.name: Portable Storage Containment & Durable JSON Persistence
boundaries.privilegeContext: Standard user filesystem permissions within application root
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: data/ (executable-root-local only; zero %APPDATA%, %LOCALAPPDATA%, %USERPROFILE%, or Registry state writes)

validationRules.atomicWriteStrategy: Two-phase commit via unique temporary sibling file, FlushFileBuffers, and MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH rename
validationRules.unwritableRootPolicy: Fails with StorageErrorCode::DirectoryNotWritable; never falls back to external paths
validationRules.privateModePolicy: Suppresses durable disk mutation for history, session, updater, and recent streams

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Direct disk corruption or unauthorized external process modification of JSON files in application data directory.

boundaries.name: Diagnostics, Local Logging, and Crash/Hang Dumps
boundaries.trustLevel: Process memory and exception filter state

validationRules.telemetryTransmission: None (zero remote telemetry; all logs and dumps remain strictly local)

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Process crash dumps may contain sensitive in-memory strings or paths present in process RAM at time of failure.

boundaries.name: Windows Shell Verb Registration & Taskbar Integration
boundaries.trustLevel: Windows taskbar COM interface (transient UI state only)
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: None (shell registration and JumpList implementation removed; taskbar integration stores no durable state outside the application root)
boundaries.failureErrorCode: Taskbar integration reports HRESULT/bool failures; no shell registration API exists

validationRules.registryScope: Disabled: no writes to HKEY_CURRENT_USER or any other hive (strict portable containment)
validationRules.commandLineEncapsulation: Not applicable: no shell verbs registered
validationRules.applicationStateStorage: Prohibited from Windows Registry and %APPDATA% (all state stays under the application root)

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: None from shell writes (disabled). Media is opened in-app via picker, drag/drop, or CLI.

boundaries.name: Localization Catalogs & Custom mpv Configuration Filtering
boundaries.trustLevel: Local user-provided or package-supplied configuration and translation files

validationRules.mpvSecurityBlacklist: Blocks scripts, Lua/JS, IPC servers, config includes, file dumps, network/TLS overrides, and window/DLL hijacking

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: Complex custom mpv rendering options leading to high GPU/CPU utilization or unexpected visual presentation.

boundaries.name: UI Drag & Drop and Clipboard Input Boundary
boundaries.trustLevel: Untrusted desktop window manager and clipboard data transfers
boundaries.durableWriteDestination: None directly (in-memory parsing and dispatch to playback/queue)

validationRules.droppedUrlSanitization: Extracted via NetworkStreamValidator with strict scheme and character checks

boundaries.residualRiskSummary: User inadvertently dropping untrusted media or URLs into the player window triggering media demuxing.
